correctness.rationale: For each phase, a direct transition argument proves a first-return shift trichotomy (1, p-j, p); n=prefix length+first shift iff a complete first return. For n<=p there are only unary and equal-wing two-transition closed factors. For n>p counting ordinary h-1 remainders and one possible parity remainder yields the displayed formula; phase distinctness proves exact cardinality and P(n)=min(n,a)+min(n,b). Both halves of the sharp cutoff are proved including a=b=1. The finite verifier independently computes borders and factor sets: 5,254 checks for 1<=a,b<=12; a separate sweep covered 10,010 checks for 1<=a,b<=15. Finite checks are not used as infinite certification.
